rachel_cs: Heads-up: Solara onboarding. Their chat p95 spikes during morning bursts (baseline ~260ms, spiked to ~820ms). Renewal in 5 weeks — want proactive perf plan (quant + routing + cache).
omar_se: Do we have seq len distribution?
rachel_cs: Median ~120 tokens, ~10% of requests hit >400 tokens. Spikes correlate with mobile notifications.
vijay_sre: Suggest adaptive routing: short/medium -> compact-int4, long -> large baseline. Also prefix/KV cache for repeated system context.
nina_pe: Goal: show ~30% peak reduction with <1% quality delta on golden set. Can CS assemble 80 live prompts + 20 golden?
rachel_cs: Yes, will share today.
omar_se: Draft route config for ops:
```
route: solara_chat
policies:
  - name: adaptive_short
    selector: request.seq_len <= 250
    model_candidates: [rw-ggml-compact-int4, rw-ggml-compact-ffn]
    weight: 0.10
  - name: baseline_long
    selector: request.seq_len > 250
    model: rw-ggml-large-v1
fallback: baseline_long
```
vijay_sre: I'll provision a tiny dedicated pool for short-path and enable KV cache. Canary plan: 10% traffic for 24h, auto-rollback if golden_set delta >1% or hallucination alerts.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: solara-adaptive-canary (10%) -> rw-ggml-compact-int4 at 2026-04-07T07:00:00Z. Alerts -> #cs-quality.
rachel_cs: I'll run the eval and coordinate enablement session Thu 10am PT. Thanks team :thumbsup:
